items.title: Court voids No Surprises Act formula used to settle billing disputes - Insurance Business
items.reason: This directly addresses No Surprises Act litigation involving judicial interpretation of the IDR settlement formula, which is a core component of the Act's implementation and enforcement.
items.summary: A court has voided a formula established under the No Surprises Act that was being used to resolve independent dispute resolution (IDR) billing disputes between insurers and healthcare providers. This litigation outcome affects how disputed out-of-network bills are calculated and settled under the Act's balance-billing protections. The decision impacts revenue-cycle teams by potentially changing the methodology for resolving payment disputes and may require adjustments to how organizations handle IDR claims and disputes.
